infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BuyMeCart needs camera access to capture KYC documents, applicant selfies, shop photographs, and 30-second Video KYC recordings.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BuyMeCart needs microphone access for recording audio and dynamic OTP recitation during 30-second Video KYC onboarding.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BuyMeCart needs photo library access to upload identity proofs, PAN cards, MSME certificates, and cancelled cheques.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID for rapid and secure authentication to your BuyMeCart + IBNK authorized merchant wallet.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow BuyMeCart to access camera for document scanning, merchant selfie capture, and Video KYC.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow BuyMeCart to authenticate using biometric sensors.
